resources.string: HorizonCam needs camera access to work. Microphone is used for video sound.

Your video stays level, even if you rotate the phone a full 360°.
• The yellow frame is exactly what gets recorded. It stays level with the real horizon. • Record landscape while holding the phone upright: tap the frame button in the bottom bar. • 360° Lock crops the most; Auto Level crops less and fixes tilts up to ±30°.
One-handed gestures • Tap to focus, long-press to lock focus and exposure. • Swipe up or down on the preview to change brightness. • Drag sideways on the lens buttons (or pinch) to zoom. • Swipe left or right to switch Photo / Video / Time-lapse. • Volume keys take a photo or start recording.
